sql: select 'pp_status' as what, coalesce(status,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v   from paper_positions where strategy='Emmsell10' group by status union all select 'pp_atlphi', market_ticker, concat(coalesce(status,'-'),' opened=',coalesce(opened_at::text,'-'))   from paper_positions where strategy='Emmsell10' and market_ticker like '%26SEP061310ATLPHI%' union all select 'pt_status', coalesce(status,'-'), count(*)::text   from paper_trades where strategy='Emmsell10' group by status union all select 'pp_twin_status', coalesce(status,'-'), count(*)::text   from paper_positions where strategy='Emmsell10_pt4' group by status union all select 'pp_gmmsell1_status', coalesce(status,'-'), count(*)::text   from paper_positions where strategy='Gmmsell1' group by status order by 1,2
